title: The Souls of AI: Why Beating Dark Souls Is a More Meaningful Benchmark Than Beating Atari
summary: The Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE) uses all 22 boss encounters from Dark Souls: Remastered as a benchmark for AI agents. No current method can beat past the tutorial boss, revealing the limits of deep reinforcement learning and offering a far more demanding test of reasoning than Atari ever did.
